Triage: lands in `domain:server` (schema sync, SQL drivers) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:data · Bug · when metadata drops or changes a literal `defaultValue`, schema sync leaves the old physical column `DEFAULT` on every database an earlier release created. Every unset insert keeps storing the old value, and nothing says so. Measured on `sys_notification_preference.digest` (#35123 ruling B ships a stopgap hook); every other such field is read from code. Data is silently wrong, which is p1 under the 2026-11-21 standard → **p1** (was p2) · size M.
